title: Caribbean Culinary Culture
summary: Caribbean: jerk seasoning, rice and peas, coconut oil.
origins: Caribbean cuisine reflects latin geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Fresh lime, chili heat, and masa or rice — brightness against rich proteins.
teaching: Char chilies and tomatoes, bloom cumin in fat, finish with cilantro and lime never cooked long.
Dried chilies, cumin, corn products, and fresh lime are non-negotiable.
Signature pairing: jerk seasoning + rice and peas + coconut oil.
